تجتلون (form VIII)
# تَجْتَلُونَ (tajtalūna) /tad͡ʒ.ta.luː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِجْتَلَى (ijtalā)
# تُجْتَلَوْنَ (tujtalawna) /tud͡ʒ.ta.law.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِجْتَلَى (ijtalā)
